justification: The [source’s Section 10](https://arxiv.org/html/1206.1893v7#S10) confirms that the cited display drops the expectation present in (126). This inference is invalid: if Y is 0 or 1 equiprobably, D=c/4 satisfies D≤cE[Y] but violates D≤cY when Y=0. Conditioning on M₀ leaves ξ random. This missing-expectation defect differs from the ground-truth Gaussian scaling error.
